title: Parser Regression Investigation — Failure Classification
root_cause:
All 20 failures share a single root cause: test file test_boq_intelligence_increment3.py constructs BOQRow objects with incorrect positional argument ordering.

BOQRow fields are: (row_number, code, description, quantity, uom, row_type, section=None)
Tests pass arguments as: (row_number, row_type, code, description, quantity, uom, section)

This swaps 'row_type' and 'uom' positions. The UOM string ('m', 'Head1') ends up in the row_type field. Production _count_row_types() correctly rejects these as unknown row types because:
- _VALID_ROW_TYPES = {'Head','Note','Section','Item','Other'} (classification set)
- 'm' is a UOM value, not a classification → _classify_row('m') → 'Item'
- 'Head1' is a UOM string, not a classification → _classify_row('Head1') → 'Head'

The production code is CORRECT. The tests have a field-ordering bug.

The non-failing test file (test_boq_intelligence.py) uses production fixture rows from extract_boq() which always produce correct row_type values.
recommendation:
FIX TESTS ONLY. Production code is correct.

Disposition: Outdated Test — fix all 20 tests to use correct BOQRow field ordering.
Approach: Convert all BOQRow positional constructions in test_boq_intelligence_increment3.py to keyword arguments to prevent field-ordering bugs.

Example correction:
  Before: BOQRow(1, 'Item', 'A001', 'Test item', 10.0, 'm', 'SECTION_A')
  After:  BOQRow(row_number=1, code='A001', description='Test item', quantity=10.0, uom='m', row_type='Item', section='SECTION_A')

Expected fix produces 103/103 tests passing.

failures.root_cause:
Backward compat test uses raw UOM 'm' as row_type instead of 'Item'

BOQRow fields order: (row_number, code, description, quantity, uom, row_type, section=None). Test uses BOQRow(row_number, row_type_as_code, code_as_desc, desc_as_qty, qty_as_uom, uom_as_row_type, section) — 6th positional arg is UOM string 'm' mapped to row_type field. Correct: BOQRow(..., uom='m', row_type='Item', ...). 

Production _classify_row() maps UOM='m' → row_type='Item' (via _ITEM_UOMS frozenset). Production _VALID_ROW_TYPES = {'Head','Note','Section','Item','Other'} — 'm' not in set.
evidence_refs: boq_intelligence.py:123-124 (if row.row_type not in _VALID_ROW_TYPES: raise ValueError)
failures.recommended_disposition: Fix test: Use keyword args or correct positional order: BOQRow(row_number=N, code='A001', description='...', quantity=10.0, uom='m', row_type='Item', section='SECTION_A')
